**Which zip?**

- `gx-like-dark-mode-vX.zip`: recommended, CSS filter engine, no warning bar.
- `gx-like-dark-mode-native-vX.zip`: Chrome's built-in Auto Dark Mode engine, closest to Opera GX, shows Chrome's debugging bar (see the README).

**Install:** unzip, open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer mode, click Load unpacked and pick the unzipped folder.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ImJustPro/gx-like-dark-mode/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.
